column1: # Italian glossary. CLAUDE-ONLY PROPOSAL (2026-11-05): drafted by one model, not judged by the council; nothing here is final, safety rows included.
# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Italian, forms separated by " | ". Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them. Evidence and reasons are in l10n/style/it.md.
# Rows D3 retires keep the chosen term's Italian until en.tsv drops them. D3's new and renamed rows wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/it.tsv until D3 merges (scratch/lang/glossary_hold.py restore it).

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Velocità di punta and the measured value Velocità massima, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand. Other keys with these terms already match D3.
